description: This file contains test fixtures and helper functions for testing a FastAPI application that processes binary payloads, particularly related to LPT.bin files. It includes functions to create binary data streams, set up test clients, and utilities for filesystem operations.

methods.name: bytes _pack_header(magic: int, version: int, record_count: int, reserved: int)
methods.description: Pack header fields into bytes using struct with little-endian format.

methods.name: bytes _pack_record( timestamp: float, value1: float, value2: float, status: int, flags: int, reserved: int, )
methods.description: Pack record fields into bytes using struct with little-endian format.

methods.name: bytes lpt_bin_bytes_valid_two_records()
methods.description: Fixture that returns a valid LPT.bin byte payload with 2 records.

methods.name: bytes lpt_bin_bytes_header_only_record_count_0()
methods.description: Fixture that returns a header-only payload indicating zero records.

methods.name: callable make_lpt_bin_bytes()
methods.description: Factory fixture to build custom LPT.bin bytes with specified record count and records.

methods.name: TestClient api_client(tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch)
methods.description: Fixture that sets environment variables, reloads the API main module, and returns a TestClient for testing the FastAPI app.

methods.name: callable temp_dir_file_snapshot(tmp_path: Path)
